title: Symfony 6 intranet migration: eleven weekends, zero downtime
lede: Eleven weekends, one strangler proxy, and a timesheet form that never went dark. How an in-house team moved a 2011 custom-PHP intranet onto Symfony 6 without anyone noticing.
hero_alt: Overhead desk with hand-inked migration diagram, manila folder, wall calendar, stamped timesheet, brass plate, fountain pen, wax seal.
